description: This file defines a static class PredefinedFontsAndChars within the MigraDoc namespace, specifying font names and characters used for error messages and bulleted list levels in MigraDoc documents. It includes nested static class Bullets for managing bullet characters and associated font names.

classes.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars
classes.description: Defines default font families and characters used for error messages, document info in RTF, and bulleted list levels within MigraDoc documents.

classes.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.Bullets
classes.description: Nested static class managing font names and characters for bullet points at different list levels.

methods.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.Reset
methods.description: Resets all font and character properties to their initial default values, including bullet list level font names and characters.
